title: Engine gate runs leave uncommitted, un-gitignored Config/ mutations (incl. a machine-specific SecurityToken)
location: scripts/run-tests-headless.sh:46-49 (engine invocations); artifacts at Config/DefaultEngine.ini, Config/DefaultInput.ini
evidence:
Observed in this worktree after the gate runs recorded in docs/timings.md (19:44:29-19:45:21) — git status:
 M Config/DefaultEngine.ini
 M docs/timings.md
?? Config/DefaultInput.ini
git diff Config/DefaultEngine.ini:
+[/Script/AndroidFileServerEditor.AndroidFileServerRuntimeSettings]
+bEnablePlugin=True
+bAllowNetworkConnection=True
+SecurityToken=C733964B95454DAABA35AB85F8221638
The cause — run-tests-headless.sh boots the editor per gate:
    "$ENGINE_CMD" "$UPROJECT" \
      -unattended -nopause -nullrhi -nosound -nosplash \
      -ExecCmds="Automation RunTests PacketPlumber" \
.gitignore has no rule for these (only Binaries/, Saved/, etc.): '# --- Keep tracked (do NOT ignore): .mcp.json, ue-mcp.yml, docs/, Source/, Config/, *.uproject'
detail: Every UnrealEditor-Cmd run (gates 4-6) makes the editor write AndroidFileServer settings + SecurityToken into DefaultEngine.ini and generate DefaultInput.ini — untracked, un-ignored, unguarded by any gate. A later git add -A commits machine noise, violating AGENTS.md ("Config/*.ini changes are code review surface"; "never commit secrets").
recommended_fix: In run-tests-headless.sh, restore engine-mutated files after gates (git checkout -- Config/DefaultEngine.ini; rm Config/DefaultInput.ini) or add an explicit pre-commit/gate guard listing engine-generated Config artifacts.

title: format-check.sh's engine-bundled clang-format path does not exist on macOS UE 5.8.1 (Windows layout)
evidence:
Script:
for cand in \
  /Users/Shared/Epic\ Games/UE_5.8/Engine/Extras/ThirdPartyNotUE/CLang/bin/clang-format \
  "$(command -v clang-format 2>/dev/null || true)"; do
Header comment: '# Prefers the engine-bundled clang-format (UE 5.8 ships one); falls back to a
# system clang-format >= 14.'
Verified on the installed engine: 'ls: /Users/Shared/Epic Games/UE_5.8/Engine/Extras/ThirdPartyNotUE/CLang/bin/: No such file or directory' (ThirdPartyNotUE contains CMake, ninja-build, putty, etc. — no CLang dir; find over Engine/Extras returns no clang-format). Gate run used the fallback: 'format: all Source/ files clean (/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin/clang-format)'
detail: The first candidate is dead on this Mac install and the "UE 5.8 ships one" premise is false on macOS. The gate works here only via the Homebrew fallback; on an engine-present machine without system clang-format, gate 1 degrades to SKIP despite the engine being installed.
recommended_fix: Drop the dead engine path (or correct it for macOS) and document the real requirement: a system clang-format >= 14 for the format gate.

title: Comments call PacketPlumberCoreTests "Developer type" but the uproject declares Type: UncookedOnly
detail: "Developer" is not a UE module type; the module is declared UncookedOnly. The described behavior (editor + commandlet, never ships) matches UncookedOnly, but the comments misname the wiring and can mislead agents editing module loading.
recommended_fix: Change both comments to say "UncookedOnly" to match PacketPlumberUE.uproject.
